patterns.label: Transaction fact
use_when: Rows represent discrete business events
Table contains additive numeric measures
A clear event grain can be documented
anti_pattern_warnings: Do not update immutable facts except through correction rows

patterns.label: SCD Type 2 dimension
use_when: Rows describe business entities
Attribute history matters for point-in-time reporting
A stable natural key exists
anti_pattern_warnings: Do not join SCD2 facts to mutable natural keys for point-in-time analytics

patterns.label: Date dimension
use_when: Many models need shared calendar or fiscal attributes
Date filtering and reporting periods must be consistent
anti_pattern_warnings: Avoid recomputing common date attributes in every query

patterns.label: Bridge table
use_when: A fact or entity relates to multiple dimension members
Many-to-many attribution or weighting is required
anti_pattern_warnings: Do not duplicate fact measures through many-to-many joins without attribution rules

patterns.label: Audit/event log
use_when: Rows capture state changes or operational events
Append-only lineage or compliance history is required
anti_pattern_warnings: Do not use an unpartitioned event table for high-volume time-series workloads

patterns.label: Periodic snapshot fact
use_when: Rows represent entity state at a regular interval
Missing activity still needs a row for reporting
anti_pattern_warnings: Do not confuse event transactions with periodic snapshots

patterns.label: Data Vault hub/link/satellite
use_when: Multiple source systems require auditable integration
Business keys and relationship history must remain source-traceable
anti_pattern_warnings: Do not model every descriptive attribute in hubs or links

patterns.label: Medallion layered model
use_when: Raw, conformed, and business-ready layers need separate contracts
Lineage and quality gates matter before KPI or BI consumption
anti_pattern_warnings: Gold outputs should not derive directly from raw Bronze sources

patterns.label: Semi-structured JSON payload
use_when: Source schema varies by event type or source version
Sparse attributes should not become hundreds of nullable columns
anti_pattern_warnings: Do not leave frequently queried measures only inside JSON payloads
